name: MADCASH-1 (Hubble)
blurb: MADCASH-1, a faint dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: madcash1-hubble
story: MADCASH-1 is a faint dwarf galaxy orbiting the spiral galaxy NGC 2403, a host about as massive as the Large Magellanic Cloud. Its stars are predominantly old and metal-poor, much like faint dwarfs in our own Local Group.

claims.text: MADCASH-1 is a faint dwarf satellite galaxy of NGC 2403
MADCASH-1 is also designated MADCASH J074238+652501-dw
NGC 2403 is a low-mass spiral galaxy of LMC stellar mass
MADCASH-1 is a predominantly old, metal-poor stellar system resembling Local Group dwarfs
